blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Numbers tell stories at work. At Czarnikow, numbers are everywhere. We talk about price, cost, total and discount every day.

The price is how much you pay for one thing. The cost is the money the company spends. The total is all the numbers together. A discount makes the price smaller — that is good news for clients.

Today we practise the most useful numbers in English. Take your time. Every sentence counts, and small words like these help you talk about money with confidence.

items.q: According to the text, what is 'price'?
options: How much you pay for one thing
items.why: "The price is how much you pay for one thing."

items.q: What is the 'total'?
items.why: "The total is all the numbers together."

items.q: A discount makes the price…
items.why: "A discount makes the price smaller."

items.q: The text says a discount is 'good news for clients'. This suggests that clients…
items.why: Inferência: se o desconto é boa notícia, é porque os clientes gostam de pagar menos.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: numbers are not useful at work
simple number words help you talk about money
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que essas palavras ajudam você a falar de dinheiro com confiança.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falando com um colega novo na Czarnikow. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! I am Sophie. Welcome to the team. It is your first day, so today I want to help you with numbers in English. They are easy, and we use them every day here at Czarnikow.

Look at this report on my desk. It has fifty pages. On page one, we have twenty clients. That is a good number for this month, and I am very happy with it.

Now, look at the price here. This bag of sugar has a price of ten dollars. The cost for the company is low, so this is good for us. And when a client buys a lot of sugar, we give a discount. Today the discount is fifteen percent. Clients love a discount!

Here is the total. We have twenty clients, and each one pays ten dollars — so the total is two hundred dollars. Easy, yes? You just put the numbers together.

Take your time. Say the numbers slowly with me: ten, twenty, fifty, one hundred. Do not worry if it is slow at first. Every sentence counts, and you learn a little more each day. You can do this!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many pages does the report have?
items.why: "It has fifty pages."

items.q: What is the price of the bag of sugar?
items.why: "This bag of sugar has a price of ten dollars."

items.q: What is the discount today?
items.why: "Today the discount is fifteen percent."

items.q: Sophie says the cost for the company is low. This suggests that…
options: the price is a good deal for the company
items.why: Inferência: custo baixo e preço de dez dólares é um bom negócio para a empresa.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie?
options: Kind and patient with a new colleague
items.why: Inferência: ela dá boas-vindas, fala devagar e diz 'você consegue' — é gentil e paciente.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The price is ten dollars." A price is…
items.why: Price = preço: quanto você paga por algo.

items.q: "The cost is low, so the company is happy." Cost is…
items.why: Cost = custo: o dinheiro que a empresa gasta.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Add all the numbers and give me the ___."
items.why: Total = total: todos os números somados.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The client buys a lot, so we give a ___ of ten percent."
items.why: Discount = desconto: preço menor para o cliente.

items.q: "My phone number is easy to remember." A number is…
items.why: Number = número: uma cifra como 5, 10 ou 20.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do dia a dia com números e dinheiro. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "How much does this cost?" You are asking about…
items.why: 'How much does this cost?' = Quanto custa isto? — você pergunta o preço.

items.q: "Can I get a discount?" You are asking for…
items.why: 'Can I get a discount?' = Posso ter um desconto? — você pede um preço menor.

items.q: "That is a good deal." A good deal means…
options: a good price for what you get
items.why: 'Good deal' = bom negócio: você paga um bom preço pelo que recebe.

items.q: "Let me add up the numbers." To add up means to…
options: put the numbers together to find the total
items.why: 'Add up' = somar: juntar os números para achar o total.

items.q: "Sugar is not cheap this month; it is quite expensive." Expensive means…
options: it costs a lot of money
items.why: 'Expensive' = caro: custa muito dinheiro (o contrário de cheap).
